name: openamx
description: OpenAMX is an open-source, text-based, computable document format for engineering knowledge.

scripts.dev: bun -e "require('node:fs').mkdirSync('dist', { recursive: true })" && bun --watch src/cli.ts render examples/01_First_Computable_Document.amx --out dist/01_First_Computable_Document.html
scripts.render:hello: bun run dist/cli.js render examples/01_First_Computable_Document.amx --out dist/01_First_Computable_Document.html
scripts.render:transformer: bun run dist/cli.js render examples/02_Expressions_and_Decisions.amx --out dist/02_Expressions_and_Decisions.html
scripts.render:fleet: bun run dist/cli.js render examples/03_Collections_and_Functions.amx --out dist/03_Collections_and_Functions.html
scripts.render:typed: bun run dist/cli.js render examples/12_Complete_Asset_Screening_Report.amx --input asset=examples/data/asset.json --input screenings=examples/data/screenings.csv --input reviewedAt=examples/data/reviewed-at.json --out dist/12_Complete_Asset_Screening_Report.html
